$comment: TASK-1050 W1 — the guardrail WIRE VOCABULARY, frozen once for every reader.
packages/async-contract/src/run-protocol.ts (the notice schema inside the run protocol)
Python:     apps/guardrail (W2a) and apps/harness (W2f) mirror these lists and must read this file in a parity test.
Every value on the wire is lowercase snake_case except the consultation processingReason codes, which keep the
existing SCREAMING_SNAKE machine-code style of `Consultation.processingReason` (a String column).
Prisma enums (W0) may spell members in SCREAMING_CASE; `prismaMappingTodo` lists the mappings the orchestrator
reconciles on merge. The wire value is the lowercase one in every case.

defaultMessages.guardrail.warning.generic: A safety check flagged this content. Review it before you rely on it.
defaultMessages.guardrail.blocked.inbound: A safety check stopped this request. Review the flagged input to continue.
defaultMessages.guardrail.blocked.outbound: A safety check withheld the generated content. Review it to continue.
defaultMessages.guardrail.blocked.not_medical: This content is outside clinical documentation, so it was not processed. Review the flagged input to continue.
defaultMessages.guardrail.blocked.redaction_unavailable: Patient details could not be protected before sending to an external model, so processing is paused. Retry to continue.
defaultMessages.guardrail.unverified.generic: A safety check could not run, so this content was not verified. Review it before you rely on it.
